text.offer: Looking for a bit of sport? The Arena of Kraanan is just through the foyer off East Ende, and the crowd there loves a newcomer. Stand in the stands and press the crossed swords by your map: the Arena window lets you join a mock battle. You and three fighters, everyone against everyone. Nobody dies in a mock bout. Lose, and you wake in the stands with a sore head. Go and fight one, win or lose, and I'll stand you a drink. And when you're tougher, a hundred health or more, the Arena of Death in East Ende takes duels against real killers.

text.complete: Back on your feet, I see! Win or lose, the crowd got its show. Here, on the house. Keep at it: the arena keeps a record of every bout you fight.
